newsitem.title: PERU: Peru chooses banks for Luz del Sur local shr sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru chooses banks for Luz del Sur local shr sale.

text.p: The Peruvian government has chosen Banco Continental to lead a group of banks handling the local portion of a placement of state-held shares in electricity distributor Luz del Sur, privatization officials said Tuesday.

The government, which hopes to sell all its 30 percent stake in Luz del Sur in placements at home and abroad, also chose Banco de Credito, Interbanc and Banco Wiese to form part of the syndicate, which will oversee the sale in Peru.
The bank handling the overseas portion of the placement has yet to selected, they added.
The sale - both in Peru and abroad - is expected to go ahead in the final quarter of the year, according to government officials.

In June 1994, a consortium consisting of Chile's Chilquinta International Inc. and Canada's Ontario Hydro Inc. bought a 60 percent stake in Luz del Sur, a former state-run electricity company, for $212.1 million.
Another 10 percent stake is owned by the company's workers.
